about: D31 (decision log): for each of the 300 differential seeds of MatcherScalingTests, the result digest before D31 (this tree with the envelope search off, `trajectory_graph._ENVELOPE = False`, which gives D30's digest, the `after` of execution_store_match_digests_d30.json), the digest after it, and every patient result that changed, as "status[/note or reason] -> status[/note or reason]". Every change starts from an undecided result (unresolved, or incomplete for an undecided relaxation set); it ends decided (exact, none, not_comparable) or still undecided or incomplete. D31MovementTests recomputes every entry.
